limit: Only 23 exact old full-SHA tag pairs are eligible, oldest first. The script never removes a container, attachment volume, file or release directory; it uses docker image rm --no-prune without --force. It requires at least 1,250,000,000 bytes over the normal headroom threshold before a fresh build and reruns the release guard. Actual reclaimed bytes remain unknown until production execution.
